# C-EQ 3.5 — Less battery and a welcome guide

## ✨ New / Novedades
- **Less battery on the live wallpaper**: choose 30 or 60 frames per second (now real 60 or 30 on 90 and 120 Hz screens too), and the wallpaper stops redrawing by itself when nothing is playing. It comes back when the music starts, when you touch the skin or when something on it changes; a long song title keeps scrolling. / **Menos batería**: 30 o 60 cuadros por segundo y pausa sola cuando no suena nada.
- **Welcome guide**: the first time, the permissions in order (notifications, spectrum, what's playing, Bluetooth) with what each one is for and a check mark when it's done. If Android stopped asking for a permission, "Allow" opens the app's settings. You can reopen it from Credits. / **Guía de inicio** con los permisos en orden.
- **The spectrum behind the skin's equalizer curve is now an option**, off by default, like the original Winamp. / **El espectro detrás del ecualizador del skin pasa a ser opcional.**

## ⬇️ Install / Instalar
Download **C-EQ-3.5.apk** below (Android 8.0+). It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings. / Se instala encima de las versiones anteriores sin perder tus ajustes.
